final: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions), above_overall AS (SELECT oa.avg_remain, oa.avg_remain - o.avg_remain AS excess_overall FROM order_averages AS oa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE oa.avg_remain > o.avg_remain), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_remain FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_remain), AVG(a.excess_overall), AVG(a.avg_remain - g.avg_remain) FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_remain > g.avg_remain
